intro: Interpret requests, availability and conditions in booking messages. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Bonjour, je voudrais réserver deux nuits à partir du 6 octobre.
frases.alumno: Hello, I would like to book two nights from 6 October.

frases.estudio: Une chambre avec deux lits est-elle disponible ?
frases.alumno: Is a room with two beds available?

frases.estudio: L'hôtel répond qu'il reste une chambre, mais sans vue sur la mer.
frases.alumno: The hotel replies that one room is left, but without a sea view.

frases.estudio: Le tarif inclut le parking; la réservation sera définitive après le versement d'un acompte.
frases.alumno: The rate includes parking; the booking will be final once a deposit is paid.

texto: Interpret requests, availability and conditions in booking messages. Link the subject with the request and check the dates, conditions and actions the message asks you to carry out.
Point to note: « Serait-il possible de… » softens a request; the date and duration details limit the scope of the answer. In this passage, «disponible» means «available».
